title: Genre-Specific User Enthusiasm
scenario: Find games that are in the Top 10% by user_score within their specific genre.
tableSchema: games (game_id INT, genre VARCHAR), ratings (game_id INT, user_score NUMERIC)
correctQuery: SELECT game_id FROM (SELECT game_id, PERCENT_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY genre ORDER BY user_score DESC) as pr FROM games g JOIN ratings r ON g.game_id = r.game_id) t WHERE pr <= 0.1;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE games (game_id INT, genre VARCHAR); CREATE TABLE ratings (game_id INT, user_score NUMERIC);
